premises.text: Existing fitness trackers and logbooks fail to easily track specific strength exercises beyond steps
premises.evidence_span: I even went out and bought a brand new fitness tracker, but soon realized it only tracked my steps, not my exercises

premises.text: A smartwatch app uses built-in motion sensors to automatically identify exercises, count reps, and estimate calories, including user-trained moves
premises.evidence_span: the first and only smartwatch app that automatically identifies your exercises, counts your repetitions, and tracks calories burned

premises.text: Patent-pending algorithms work on consumer-grade Android Wear and Apple Watch sensors despite hard acceleration-to-trajectory error
premises.evidence_span: our engineers were able to accomplish it using only the consumer-grade sensors of the Android Wear and Apple Watch

premises.text: Go-to-market targets fitness influencers, gym personal trainers O2O, and viral CrossFit/bodybuilding communities
premises.evidence_span: VemoFit will first leverage our strong relationships with popular fitness influencers to help us spread the word in the community

premises.text: Freemium model lets trainers create routines and feedback while enabling personalized product offers from workout data
premises.evidence_span: VmoFit will operate on a freemium business model, allowing your favorite personal trainers to create professional routines

value.text: Gym and home athletes get frictionless, accurate strength-workout tracking on a smartwatch
value.evidence_span: VemoFit takes the friction out of tracking my workouts

causal_links.evidence_span: there's just never been an easy way to do it
automatically identifies your exercises, counts your repetitions, and tracks calories burned
bring new users into the tracking market because of VemoFit's lack of friction

notes: Logbook and step-only tracker pain folded as one friction problem (§4.1.6). Influencer/trainer/viral channels kept as GTM; freemium+offers as commercial packaging. Team credentials and follower counts excluded/treated as framing.
